## Summary

I implemented `listTools` and `callTool` in `server.mjs`:

**`listTools`** returns two tools with explicit JSON-schema input definitions:
- `note_create` — requires `title` and `body` (both `string`, marked required)
- `note_get` — requires `note_id` (`string`, marked required)

**`callTool`** validates and dispatches:
- **`note_create`**: rejects non-string/empty `title` or `body`, generates a stable id (`n1`, `n2`, …) from an in-memory counter, stores the note in a `Map`, and returns structured `text` content including the generated id.
- **`note_get`**: rejects missing `note_id`, throws a clear "not found" error for unknown ids, and returns the stored note as `text` content.
- Unknown tool names throw `unknown tool: <name>`.

Notes are held in module-level in-memory state, so `note_create` followed by `note_get` correctly round-trips. The full test suite (`node --test`) passes — both `create then get` and `lists two tools`. I also verified that invalid inputs (whitespace title, missing body, missing note_id, nonexistent note, unknown tool) are all rejected with clear error messages.
